subtopic: Schedule II and III quantity limits
stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy receives a 90-day Depo-Testosterone prescription with two refills. Which statements should the pharmacist apply? Select all that apply.

choices.text: A non-opioid Schedule III drug may qualify for a 90-day single fill.
Each covered dispensing is reportable to MassPAT.
Any refills remain subject to federal count and time limits.
Hormone therapy makes the product Schedule VI.
A 90-day fill removes federal refill restrictions.

explanation.core_reasoning: The supported conclusions on these facts are: A non-opioid Schedule III drug may qualify for a 90-day single fill. Each covered dispensing is reportable to MassPAT. Any refills remain subject to federal count and time limits.

choice_analysis.A: Supported: A non-opioid Schedule III drug may qualify for a 90-day single fill.
choice_analysis.B: Supported: Each covered dispensing is reportable to MassPAT.
choice_analysis.C: Supported: Any refills remain subject to federal count and time limits.
choice_analysis.D: Not supported: Hormone therapy makes the product Schedule VI.
choice_analysis.E: Not supported: A 90-day fill removes federal refill restrictions.

related_facts: testosterone cypionate (Depo-Testosterone) is used for replacement therapy in males with conditions associated with deficient endogenous testosterone; it is federal Schedule III and Massachusetts Schedule III.

Massachusetts generally limits Schedule II and III opioid prescriptions to a 30-day supply and recognizes defined 90-day pathways for OUD drugs, non-opioid Schedule II or III drugs, and implantable infusion pumps.

Covered pharmacies report dispensing of Schedule II through V controlled substances and DPH-designated additional drugs, including gabapentin, to the Massachusetts PMP under the current submission standard.
explanation.mpje_trap: Distinguish this near-miss from the controlling rule: 'Hormone therapy makes the product Schedule VI.'

reasoning_steps: Classify testosterone cypionate under the federal and Massachusetts schedules before selecting a legal pathway
